mentions.name: roamr
mentions.description: A Wi-Fi network helper that evaluates the user's saved networks and tells them which one is actually best at their current location, along with the reason, while leaving the actual network switch to the user. Distributed for macOS via Homebrew and Windows via Scoop, with Linux support not fully tested.
mentions.problem: Moving around the office all day among many flaky Wi-Fi networks, the author kept getting stuck on a bad network for wherever they were sitting and had to guess which one to switch to.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built roamr: it tells you which of your saved networks is actually best where you are, and why. You still switch yourself.
mentions.author: sourabh65
